title: What Are They Listening To (WATLT)
description: Mod that lets you show/see what are you/players listening to!
body:
# What Are They Listening To (WATLT)

**Have you ever wanted to play with your friends, and show them what are you listening to? It is possible with this mod!**

You can see what other players listening to right now through _Last.fm_ in Tab menu!

![Mod preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eaf3233815ca2cfb2651d33d8e8e33cac5c145b6.png)

Or if someone doesn't have a Last.fm account (or they simply don't want to show their music), they can disable tracking.

![tracking deny](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1e95bd99ea5ed79002a0abe4c62ef126898665d1.png)

As you already noticed, it even supports album covers, _but_ not all songs on Last.fm have album covers... Though, you can add them yourself and contribute to Last.fm (I will not teach you how to do it sorry)

## Usage

This mod uses Last.fm to fetch current song, so take your favorite music streaming app and pair it with any Last.fm scrobbler to start!

You will also need a Last.FM API key to communicate with API (which is obvious). Don't worry, you can get it easily here: https://www.last.fm/api/account/create (you don't need to fill callback URL btw, keep it empty)

So, now that you have an API key and server ready to start, simply start it with this mod, then fill API key in config file (.minecraft/config/watlt-common.toml) and restart server, you are now ready to use mod!

When player first join with this mod enabled, they will be prompted to enter their Last.fm username (NOT link), or deny tracking.

![prompt](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/90a7998a64a2b844ce1365fc7a2ac930c1056b8b.png)

After that, they all set up and no more work needed! Easy, right?


## Commands

There are several commands, but they are really simple

![commands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3c07f1511d1433b5adc0af5f536549051934eff4.png)

- /lastfm set <username> - change your Last.fm username, or set it up, if you denied tracking on login
- /lastfm deny - deny tracking
- /lastfm status - debug, just debug

## I guess that's all, have fun!
